newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jardine Fleming mulls unit trust conversion.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Fleming mulls unit trust conversion.

text.p: Jardine Fleming Investment Management Ltd, the fund management arms of Jardine Fleming (Holdings) Ltd, said it proposed to convert JF Asia Select Ltd into an open-ended fund.

The plan was argeed at the time of the launch of the company, which was in 1989, but with the stated intention of giving shareholders an opportunity to convert it into an open-ended vehicle in the last quarter in 1996, it said.
Shareholders will vote on the proposal in an extraordinary general meeting on December 11, it said.
The assets of the JF Asia Select Trust will be transfered to the new unit trust and shareholders will exchange their holding of shares to the new trust, it added.
Jardin Fleming is equally owned by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd and British bank Robert Fleming.
